answer: A rotating audit committee defends the agent economy: each epoch, stake-weighted sortition picks a small panel that re-checks a random sample of agents' claimed work, tracing inputs, tool calls and outputs. A fake identity must post a stake, then survive repeated audits; every failed check burns the stake and exposes its funding trail, so a thousand sock puppets means a thousand losable stakes. Honest agents wander freely while audit load stays light, and like light through a prism, one suspicious record splits into verifiable traces marked with saffron tags.
